title: Jeff Nippard's Essentials - 4x/week
author: Adam
desc:
Warmup : 
1. Low Intensity Cardio : Pick any machine which elevates. your heart rate to 100-135 BPM
2. Front/Back Leg Swing (leg days only) : 12 each leg
3. Side/Side Leg Swing (leg days only) : 12 each leg
4. Arm Swings : 12 (Swing your arms out to the sides)
5. Cable Leg External Rotation : 15 each leg

Warmups 45% 65% 85%
Rest ~3 min

Focus on strength here. Each week add weight or reps. Keep form consistent.

Warmups 50% 70%
Rest ~2 min

Do first set wide overhand (1.5x shoulder width), second set underhand (1x shoulder width).

Warmups 60%
Rest ~2 min

Bring the dumbbells all the way down, keep your torso upright.

Dropset=3
